name: print-social-red-hiring-post-with-wave-split-and-three-megaphones
title: Red 'We Are Hiring!' post with a white wave top and three floating red megaphones
whatItIs: A square post with a white top separated from a deep red body by a wave, three black-and-red megaphones floating at different sizes, a white headline ('We Are Hiring! Join Our CREATIVE & Professional Team!'), a translucent panel of open positions, CV email and WhatsApp.
whatItMeans: Loud and celebratory; multiple megaphones feel like an announcement echoing around.
techniques: Scatter one prop at several sizes for depth.
Divide the post with a soft wave edge.
Centre all text in a single column.

vocabulary.definition: Repeating an object at different sizes for depth.
